description: Shared Renovate config for BeyondFolder Nuxt projects

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once all status checks pass
0.x minor bumps are breaking under semver: separate PR, manual review (a group only auto-merges if every update in it may)
wrangler minors can require a new @cloudflare/workers-types major, so update them together
TypeScript 7 (the Go port) ships no JS API yet, so vue-tsc, typescript-eslint and nuxt prepare crash on it
AI SDK packages pin each other's majors, so update them together
